fact: As of 7 September 2026 Lesotho has no AI-transparency, AI-risk, AI-governance or AI-sector-rules statute in force, and the Computer Crime and Cyber Security Bill (tabled 2022 and 2024) is not confirmed passed and names no AI system.
title: Lesotho: AI, scraping, privacy, cybersecurity, communications, content-moderation, age-gating, and reuse law
